question: How long was the Second Great War in StarCraft Lore (in years, rounded up)

4.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the StarCraft timeline, the Second Great War appears to have started with the zerg invasion of the Koprulu sector in 2504 (as shown in Wings of Liberty) and wrapped up with Kerrigan's defeat of Arcturus Mengsk plus the immediate aftermath in Heart of the Swarm, which lands around 2508. That span rounds up to 4 years.

1.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In-game canon the war that is normally called the Second Great War is the Brood War.

Canonically the Brood War is dated to the immediate aftermath of the death of the Overmind at Antiga Prime in 2500 and the end of the open hostilities on Char / the fall of Aiur and the re-consolidation of Kerrigan in ~2502. That is a ~2 yr, ~2 yr 4-6 mo campaign in-universe, i.e. the two calendar years 2500–2502.

Counted as a strict duration it is basically about two years of fighting, the inclusive calendar span 2500, 2501, 2502 is three calendar years, so the commonly quoted rounded-up figure is ~3 calendar years. If a strict elapsed-time figure is wanted it is ~2 yr.

5.text:
In-universe the events that Blizzard and the Chronicle material call the
Second Great War are the StarCraft II arc.

The war is conventionally dated from the start of the Terran rebellion/
the resumption of Dominion-Zerg hostilities in c. 2504 with Wings of
Liberty and the reopening of the three-way war in the Koprulu Sector,
to the effective end of the three-way Great War with the defeat of Amon
on Aiur / the fall of the Xel’Naga temples at the close of Legacy of the Void
c. 2508-2509.

That is c. 4 y 0 m – 4 y 9 m of in-universe time, i.e. nominally the
2504–2508/09 block. Rounded to a whole year the block is quoted as
about four years of fighting, ≈ 5 years on a round-up convention. It
is the ~ 5-year StarCraft II war, usually given as ~2504-2509.

2.text:
In canon the conflict that Blizzard and the Chronicles refer to as the
Second Great War is the Dominion / Protoss / Zerg war that is played out
in the StarCraft II trilogy.

It is conventionally dated to the StarCraft II era

* c. 2504 – the re-emergence of Kerrigan and the first open Zerg war
against the Terran Dominion, i.e. the opening of Wings of Liberty, and
* c. 2507 – the fall of Amon and the end of Legacy of the Void.

That is ≈ 3 yr of elapsed in-universe time, 2504 → 2507.  On a
calendar-year count the war spans the four calendar years 2504,2505,
2506 and 2507.  Elapsed ≈ 3 y, i.e. ≈ 4 calendar years rounded up.

3.text:
In canon the name is used for the Brood War that follows the
StarCraft I campaign.

After the death of the Overmind on Char in mid 2502 the fractured Zerg
broods go to war with each other and with the Terran Dominion and the
Protoss remnants.  The fighting that is normally called the Second
Great War / the Brood War is the August 2502 – ~July/August 2503
campaign that ends with Kerrigan’s consolidation of the Zerg swarm and
her departure with the Overmind’s essence.

That is ≈ 10-12 months of actual fighting, i.e. essentially one
calendar year of war, the 2502–2503 Brood War.  In whole-year
inclusive counting it is the two calendar years 2502 and 2503, so the
often quoted rounded-up figure is 1 yr of continuous hostilities,
≈ 2 yr on an inclusive calendar count.

In Blizzard/Chronicle material the Second Great War is the Brood War that follows the StarCraft I campaign. It is the second Protoss/Zerg/Terran great war after the First Great War of StarCraft I, not the StarCraft II trilogy. The StarCraft II trilogy is the third great war in that nomenclature.

On that canonical naming the open hostilities are the post-Overmind Brood War.

* Overmind death / start of the open Brood War  ~ Aug 2502
* Kerrigan’s consolidation / fall of Aiur and end of open hostilities ~ Jul/Aug 2503

That is ~10-12 months of continuous fighting, i.e. essentially one calendar year of war. Elapsed time is ~0.9-1.0 yr, ceiling/rounded up = 1 yr of active fighting.

Inclusive calendar counting is the 2502-2503 block, i.e. two calendar years 2502 and 2503, which is the “≈2 yr inclusive” figure you often see quoted as the rounded-up calendar span.

If the question setter is using the fan shorthand that conflates the StarCraft II arc with “Second Great War”, the 2504-2508/09 block is ~4 y 0 m - 4 y 9 m elapsed, ≈4 yr fighting, ≈5 yr on a strict round-up/inclusive convention. That is the 4-5 yr range Colleagues 2,4,5 are reporting, but it is not the canonical Second Great War = Brood War usage.

Canonica Blizzard/Field Manual naming is

* First Great War = the initial Terrar Confederacy / Dominion vs Zerg war that closes with the fall of the Overmind on Aiur in 2500
* Second Great War = the Brood War

That is the war that is opened by the death of the Overmind in mid-2502 and closes with Kerrigan’s consolidation of the Swarm and her departure for Char in July/August 2503.

That is the August 2502 – ~July/August 2503 campaign that is normally quoted as the Brood War.

In-universe elapsed time it is ~10-12 months of continuous hostilities, essentially one year of fighting.  On an inclusive calendar count it spans the two calendar years 2502 and 2503, i.e. the often-quoted ≈2 yr inclusive block.  Strict elapsed ~1 yr, ceiling to a whole year of continuous fighting is 1 yr, 2 yr on the inclusive calendar-year convention.

That is distinct from the StarCraft II trilogy. The StarCraft II trilogy is canonically referred to as the Great War / the Terran–Protoss–Zerg three-way war of c.2504–c.2508/2509.  If that StarCraft II Great War is what is meant by “Second Great War” in fan usage it is ~3-4 y 9 m elapsed, i.e. the calendar block 2504-2507/08, commonly quoted as ≈4 yr of fighting, ≈5 yr on a strict round-up convention.

On the canonical naming the Second Great War is the Brood War, ~1 yr elapsed, 2502-2503 inclusive.

Colleague 3's Brood War framing looks like the right starting point—canon sources and the Chronicles consistently tie the "Second Great War" label to the 2502–2503 fighting after the Overmind's death rather than the later SC2 arc. The actual combat phase runs roughly August 2502 to July/August 2503, so elapsed time is just under a year.  

Where the rounding instruction matters is the calendar-span convention the lore materials themselves use: the conflict is dated across the two distinct calendar years 2502 and 2503. When the question asks for duration "rounded up," that inclusive-year count is the standard the setting applies (compare how the original Great War is described as spanning 2499–2500 and routinely called "two years"). Treating it as a single elapsed year would ignore the explicit "rounded up" wording and the way Blizzard timelines present multi-year blocks.  

This keeps the answer cleanly at 2 without needing to import the SC2 dates that several others are citing. The continuous-hostilities language in the manuals supports the same two-year inclusive window once the rounding rule is applied.

* ~2503.07/08 Kerrigan’s consolidation of the Swarm and departure with the Overmind’s essence, end of open hostilities
